name: belis-bell
description: Belis Bell online store: plain PHP, Tailwind CSS, MySQL. Tailwind is a build-time tool only; nothing from npm runs on the server.

scripts.build:css: npm run fonts && tailwindcss -i resources/css/app.css -o public/assets/css/app.css --minify
scripts.build: npm run build:images && npm run build:css
scripts.watch:css: npm run fonts && tailwindcss -i resources/css/app.css -o public/assets/css/app.css --watch
